texts.li: {A_nameDef} has come of age, and it's time to settle what work {A_pronoun} takes up. {B_nameDef}, the best crafter in the workshop, has offered to take {A_objective} on.\n\n{A_nameDef} hasn't been asked what {A_pronoun} wants yet.
Now that {A_nameDef} is grown, {B_nameDef} wants {A_objective} in the workshop. {B_nameDef} has watched {A_objective} fiddle with broken things for years and says there's a crafter in there.

li.label: Apprentice {A_nameDef} to {B_nameDef} in crafting
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} starts in the workshop tomorrow. {B_nameDef} has already set aside a bench.

li.label: Put {A_nameDef} on the defenses
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} will spend the coming weeks at target practice and on the wall. It's tiring work, but the colony is safer for it.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} choose
li.outcome: The council asked {A_nameDef} what {A_pronoun} wanted to do. {A_nameDef} took a long time to answer, and had clearly given it some thought.

texts.li: {A_nameDef} has come of age. {B_nameDef} says the colony will need another healer before long, and that {A_nameDef} has steady hands.\n\nIt's a hard trade, and a slow one to learn.
{B_nameDef} wants an apprentice in the infirmary, and {A_nameDef} has just come of age. "I won't live forever," {B_nameDef} told the council, "and someone has to know what I know."

li.label: Apprentice {A_nameDef} to {B_nameDef} in medicine
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} now follows {B_nameDef} on every round of the sickbeds, taking notes.

li.label: The fields need hands more
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} is sent to work the fields, which should mean a better harvest. {B_nameDef} will go on tending the sick alone.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} choose
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} was asked, and thanked the council for asking.

texts.li: {A_nameDef} has come of age, and {B_nameDef} wants {A_objective} at the research bench. "There's a mind in there," {B_nameDef} says, "and it's wasted hauling rocks."
With {A_nameDef} grown, {B_nameDef} has offered to teach {A_objective} everything {B_pronoun} knows, starting with letters and numbers.

li.label: Apprentice {A_nameDef} to {B_nameDef} in study
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} spends the evenings with {B_nameDef} and a stack of old books.

li.label: Hands before books
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} is put to work on construction, and the walls are going up faster. {B_nameDef} is sulking about it.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} choose
li.outcome: The council let {A_nameDef} decide, and {A_nameDef} already knew what {A_pronoun} wanted.

texts.li: {A_nameDef} has come of age. {B_nameDef}, the colony's best shot, says {A_nameDef} has the eye for it and should start training now, before the next raid.\n\nOthers say {A_nameDef} has seen enough fighting for a lifetime already.
{A_nameDef} is grown, and wants to stand on the wall with the others. {B_nameDef} has offered to teach. Not everyone thinks that's a good idea.

li.label: Apprentice {A_nameDef} to {B_nameDef} at arms
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} is on the range at dawn every day now, with {B_nameDef} standing behind, correcting.

li.label: Not yet
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} is kept off the wall for now, and is furious about it. Some of the parents are relieved.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} choose
li.outcome: The council left the choice to {A_nameDef}, and the colony is waiting to hear what {A_pronoun} decides.
